user_query: I'm a music producer and I'm looking for new talent to collaborate with. Can you provide me with a list of up-and-coming artists in various genres? Additionally, give me some cat facts to include in my social media posts to engage with my audience.

TaskList.description: Search for up-and-coming artists across various music genres.
Gather details about the identified artists including their social media links and recent works.
Collect engaging cat facts suitable for social media sharing.
